A LITTLE PREPARATION

Comfort starts before your visit.

Aim for hair around one-quarter inch long. If you are unsure whether it is ready, contact Matrix before your appointment.

Tell us about retinol or prescription retinoids, acne medications, recent peels or resurfacing, sunburn and sensitive or irritated skin. These details can affect whether waxing is appropriate.

If you take isotretinoin or have taken it within the past six months, do not book waxing. Ask your prescriber about safe hair-removal options. Do not stop a prescribed medication to prepare for an appointment without their advice.

AFTER YOUR APPOINTMENT

Keep the finish comfortable.

Your provider will give aftercare for the area treated. A gentle approach helps you avoid adding irritation immediately after waxing.

01

Go gently

Avoid picking, harsh scrubs or aggressive exfoliation on freshly waxed skin. Ask when to resume your usual products.

02

Give skin breathing room

Follow your provider’s guidance about heat, heavy sweating, friction and clothing that rubs the treated area.

03

Plan your next visit

Results and regrowth vary. Discuss a return visit based on the area, your hair growth and how your skin responds.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few helpful details.

Feel comfortable choosing your next visit.

What waxing services do you offer?

Matrix offers Facial Waxing Services and Body Waxing. The booking menu lists the areas and combinations currently available, along with appointment times and pricing.

How long should hair be before waxing?

Hair should generally be around one-quarter inch long. If you are unsure about the length or have recently shaved, contact Matrix before booking so timing can be discussed.

Does waxing hurt?

Temporary discomfort is normal when hair is removed. Sensitivity varies by area and person. Tell your provider how you are feeling so the service can be paced around your comfort.

How long do waxing results last?

Results vary with hair growth, the area treated and your routine. Many people enjoy a smooth feel for several weeks, but there is no fixed result or regrowth schedule for everyone.

Can I wax if I use retinol or acne medication?

Tell your provider about all skincare and medications before booking. Retinoids, isotretinoin and some other products or treatments can make waxing unsafe for the skin. Do not wax while taking isotretinoin or within six months of taking it. Ask your prescriber about safe timing and alternatives.

Can I have waxing and a facial on the same day?

Ask Matrix before booking both. Suitability depends on the area, skin condition and the facial steps planned; exfoliating treatments may need separate timing.

What should I avoid after waxing?

Follow the aftercare given for your treatment area. Keep care gentle and ask about heat, sweating, friction, sun exposure and when to resume exfoliating products.

Where can I book waxing near Union Grove, Twin Lakes or Antioch?

Visit Matrix Massage & Bodywork at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. Our Salem studio serves Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Union Grove, Twin Lakes, Trevor, Bristol and nearby Antioch, Illinois. All appointments are at this Salem location. Book online or text 262-939-9325.
